customer_reply: Hello, thank you for reaching out to Zycus Support. The greyed-out Approve button when selecting 500 purchase orders is by design. Bulk approval accepts a maximum of 200 documents per batch to protect approval audit trails. To process your purchase orders, please filter your approval list into batches of 200 or fewer. If your team requires a higher batch limit, we have logged this as a feature request for the Product team.
internal_note: Customer attempted to bulk approve 500 purchase orders at once, causing the Approve button to disable. Per KB-4859, bulk approval has a strict platform limit of 200 documents per batch by design. Routed to Product as a feature request / how-to guidance provided.
